Industry Challenges

Are Manual Operations Holding Your DSA Business Back?

Most loan brokers lose 30% of potential disbursements due to fragmented tools, unorganized documents, and delayed bank follow-ups.

Leads Lost in Excel & WhatsApp

Scattered customer inquiries lead to forgotten follow-ups and unassigned leads slipping to competitors.

Commission Payout Disputes

Manual Excel calculations cause payout confusion, missing pay-ins from banks, and split disagreements with sub-agents.

Zero Team Visibility

No clear oversight of which agent is working on which file, daily call volumes, or actual monthly disbursement progress.

Document & KYC Chaos

Customer PAN cards, salary slips, and property files stored across personal WhatsApp chats and unorganized local folders.

Missed Bank Follow-ups

No automated reminder system for query resolution, leading to prolonged Turnaround Time (TAT) and application rejection.

Scaling Bottlenecks

Inability to expand sub-DSA partner networks or add new bank codes without administrative chaos.

Comprehensive CRM Capability

Everything You Need to Scale Your Loan Business

Built from the ground up to solve the specific operational workflows of financial advisors, loan brokers, and DSAs across India.

Lead Management System

Capture, assign, and track leads from website, Meta ads, partners, and referrals. Auto lead distribution and stage updates.

Multi-Bank Application Tracker

Track files across SBI, HDFC, ICICI, Axis, Kotak, and 25+ NBFCs from Draft → Login → Processing → Sanction → Disbursement.

Automated Commission Engine

Configure slab-based pay-ins, partner payouts, agent incentives, TDS (5%), and GST (18%) with real-time payout ledger.

Document & KYC Vault

Centralized customer document repository. Organize PAN, Aadhaar, salary slips, ITRs, and property papers with expiry alerts.

Sub-DSA & Partner Network

Manage external connectors and sub-agents. Track partner lead contributions, calculate referral splits, and issue statement slips.

Task & Call Scheduling

Never miss a bank query or customer call. Schedule follow-up tasks, log call results, and trigger instant WhatsApp templates.

Real-Time Reports & BI

Disbursement reports, bank TAT analysis, employee sales leaderboards, and revenue analytics exportable in CSV and PDF.

AI Loan Assistant

Ask natural language queries like "Show pending sanction files" or "Calculate expected commission for ₹50L Home Loan".
